annotations.title: Update my profile from my CV

description: Preferred way to fill the profile from a CV the user shared in chat: send the facts you read in the CV as typed fields. Without apply=true it returns a preview only. Empty profile fields are filled, lists only grow, nothing already on the profile is overwritten (the summary only with replaceSummary=true). With cvText every fact must appear in that text or it is skipped. A job without a start date is skipped and reported: ask the user for it, never guess. Date of birth, gender, marital status and pay are never accepted. The result lists applied, kept and skipped fields with reasons; tell the user exactly that.

address.description: Place line from the CV, e.g. 'Pune, Maharashtra, India'. No street address needed.

apply.description: true only after the user approved the preview.

city.description: City (and region/country) where the user lives, as in the CV.

cvText.description: Optional plain text of the CV. When given, every fact is checked against it and facts not found are skipped.

startDate.description: e.g. 2021-06 or 2021. Leave out when unknown (never guess); the entry is then reported back.

githubUrl.description: GitHub profile link from the CV.

interestedRoles.description: Roles the user wants next (job titles only).

linkedinUrl.description: LinkedIn profile link from the CV.

noticePeriod.description: Notice period as stated, e.g. '30 days'.

phone.description: Phone number exactly as in the CV.

portfolioUrl.description: Portfolio / personal site link from the CV.

replaceSummary.description: true only when the user asked to replace their current summary.

summary.description: Professional summary as written in the CV (or a faithful short version).

workPreference.description: Only if the CV states it.

name: import_profile_from_cv
